en.headline: Privacy watchdog receives 2,990 complaints in first half, up more than 60%
en.dek: The Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said information-technology cases formed the largest share, reflecting faster collection and use of personal data in the AI era and greater public awareness.
body: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data received 2,990 complaints in the first half of 2026, a year-on-year rise of more than 60 per cent, Privacy Commissioner Ada Chung Lai-ling said on Saturday.

Cases involving information technology accounted for the largest number at 867, the category she identified as her main area of concern. Chung attributed the overall increase to the speed and volume of personal-data collection, processing and use online in the artificial-intelligence era, together with heightened public awareness of privacy rights.

She noted that personal data now carries commercial value on the internet and forms part of illicit supply chains, urging people to think carefully before handing over personal information, for example when shopping online or joining membership schemes. On data-breach handling, she emphasised that organisations remain responsible even when systems are outsourced and must monitor third-party contractors.

Regarding doxxing, Chung said complaints had fallen sharply since the 2021 amendments to the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance that allow the office to investigate, gather evidence and prosecute in one place. First-half doxxing complaints numbered 144, down from thousands in 2021, while proactive online patrols detected only three cases in the same period.

zh.headline: 私隱公署上半年接2990宗投訴升逾六成 資訊科技佔最多
zh.dek: 私隱專員鍾麗玲表示，人工智能時代令網上收集及使用個人資料的速度與數量大增，加上市民意識提高，投訴因而上升。
body: 個人資料私隱專員公署今年上半年接獲2990宗投訴，按年上升超過六成。私隱專員鍾麗玲周六表示，當中涉及資訊科技的投訴最多，有867宗，亦是她最關注的範疇。
鍾麗玲相信，投訴增加主要因為人工智能時代網上收集、處理及使用個人資料的速度快、處理量大，令網上相關爭拗增加，加上市民對保障個人資料的意識提升。她指出，個人資料在網上有價有市，是不法之徒的產業鏈，呼籲市民向他人提供個人資料前要想清楚，不能掉以輕心，例如網購或加入會員時應先考慮是否需要交出相關資料。
在處理外洩事故方面，她強調機構即使聘請第三方外判商處理資訊系統，責任仍不可外判，須監察外判商的工作。
至於「起底」問題，鍾麗玲指自2021年修訂私隱條例後，公署可一站式處理調查、搜證及起訴，嚴重個案會轉介警方。2021年公署曾接獲數千宗投訴，今年上半年已跌至144宗，而主動網上巡查今年上半年只發現3宗，認為措施具成效。
